proposal.text: Q1: src/hub.ts:65 sets Hub.DEFAULT_NUDGE_MS = CHATROOM_NUDGE_AFTER_MS ?? 180_000 (applied per room at hub.ts:94). Verdict: KEEP 3 min for a nine-seat session. (a) Silence nudge armNudge (hub.ts:1036-1058) is re-armed by every post (hub.ts:985), so with nine seats it fires only when the room is genuinely stalled, and identical nudges are capped at two (hub.ts:1053-1054). (b) The same value is the blind-openings deadline: two periods at creation (hub.ts:136), one period from the first opening and not reset by chat (hub.ts:1081), plus one warning period if seats never joined (hub.ts:1093-1104); 3 min bounds how long eight seats wait on one straggler without cutting off normal spawn latency. The env var and opts.nudgeAfterMs allow overrides. Q2: exactly one duplicate in the offlineScripts list (scripts/offline-runner.mjs:26-182): bench-build-oracle-audit.test.ts, at lines 64 and 78. No others. Q3: MAX_WAIT_MS = 55_000 at src/server.ts:21, comment "stay under typical MCP client tool timeouts (Codex 60s)"; enforced by the zod max (server.ts:348) and Math.min (server.ts:359). Verdict: still justified for arbitrary external clients (default Codex 60s), even though spawned Codex seats configure tool_timeout_sec=120 (src/codex-seat.ts:13); longer idle is covered server-side by hold_until_actionable looping within the budget (server.ts:365-373), so the cap costs little.
